comment: Single source of truth for provider presets, model rates, and billing nuances. Estimates only; every provider bills you directly and murmur never sees it. Refreshed weekly by .github/workflows/pricing-watch.yml, which re-checks each rate against the vendor's primary source and opens a PR when a number drifts; the app can also fetch this file from the repo at launch (Settings, Price refresh). Rates without a currency are USD.

estimate.comment: Cleanup-pass token model shared with analytics: roughly 1.35 tokens per word each way plus a fixed per-session prompt overhead, amortized here as sessionsPer1kWords typical dictation sessions. fallbackWpm seeds the cost preview before any history exists.

providers.name: Groq
nuances: The free tier bills nothing: no card needed, hard rate limits instead. The console shows dollar-equivalent usage, but nothing is charged.
The developer tier bills only once lifetime usage passes 50 cents, then at 1, 10, 100, 500, and 1,000 dollar thresholds.

providers.name: OpenAI
nuances: The API has no free tier; usage is billed against prepaid credits from the first request.

providers.name: Mistral
nuances: Voxtral Mini Transcribe is billed per audio minute (0.003 dollars) with a published word error rate around 4 percent.
Chat models are priced in euros on Mistral's docs pricing page; the estimate shown uses those euro rates.

providers.name: Local (your machine)
nuances: Free, offline, and private: audio never leaves your machine. Needs a local server first: speaches or faster-whisper-server for speech (default port 8000), Ollama (port 11434) or LM Studio (port 1234) for cleanup.
Model ids come from whatever your local server has pulled; type the id your server reports.

providers.name: DeepSeek
nuances: Billed from a prepaid balance. Rates halve during Beijing-time off-peak hours; the estimate shown uses the full peak rate.

providers.name: Cerebras
nuances: Extremely fast inference with drop-in OpenAI compatibility. The model lineup moves quickly: pick a current model id and rates from Cerebras's own pages.

providers.name: OpenRouter
nuances: One key routes to hundreds of models from many vendors, billed through prepaid credits. Model ids look like vendor/model; per-model rates live on the OpenRouter models page.
